findings.issue: The draft changes the image from emerging from drunkenness to being in a drunken condition. The following recovery language does not fully preserve the direction expressed by ἐκ.
findings.suggested_revision: Use “As though recovering from drunkenness” and retain the following description of bodily weakness and regained self-control. Submit the revised sentence for fresh review.

findings.source_quote: Εἰπέ μοι σὺ πρῶτον (ἄλλως γὰρ τοῦτον ἰδεῖν οὐκ ἔχεις) —.
findings.english_quote: “You tell me first—for otherwise you cannot see him.”
findings.issue: The terminal printed dash is absent, and the notes do not disclose it. The draft consequently normalizes the visibly unfinished prompt. The supplied transcription establishes the printed marker, but its function should not be silently classified as either interrupted speech or an editorial omission.
findings.suggested_revision: Retain the terminal dash, for example: “You tell me first (for otherwise you cannot see him)—.” Add a note quoting the supplied Greek and explaining that the edition leaves this marker after the prompt; no completion has been supplied. Preserve uncertainty about its function rather than inventing an object for “tell me.”

findings.source_quote: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀγνοῶν ὅλον τὸ πρᾶγμα ὡς μαινομένην ἀπεσειόμην
findings.english_quote: Knowing nothing of the whole situation, I shook her off as though she were mad;
findings.issue: “I shook her off” presents the action as a completed dismissal. The imperfect ἀπεσειόμην describes the ongoing shaking-off action, which Peter addresses with ἀποσειόμενος in the next section.
findings.suggested_revision: Use “Knowing nothing of the whole situation, I was shaking her off as though she were mad” or the contextually conative “I was trying to shake her off.” Re-review the selected revision in continuity with 12.23.

findings.source_quote: οὐ γὰρ δὴ ἐμπορίας ἕνεκα ἢ στρατείας πατρίδας καταλιμπάνειν οἴδατε καὶ εἰς μακροὺς ἀπέρχεσθαι τόπους, διὰ δὲ αἰώνιον σωτηρίαν μηδὲ τριῶν ἡμερῶν ὁδὸν πορευθῆναι θέλειν.
findings.english_quote: For surely, while you know how to leave your homelands for commerce or military service and go away to distant places, for eternal salvation you are unwilling to travel even a three-days’ journey.
findings.issue: The initial οὐ has no defensible equivalent in the main wording. Even on an incredulous or rhetorical reading, it rejects or challenges the contrasted behavior; the draft instead affirmatively asserts that the hearers are unwilling to make the journey. The note identifying a rhetorical contrast does not preserve that negative force.
findings.suggested_revision: Propose wording such as: “For surely it cannot be that you know how to leave your homelands for commerce or military service and travel to distant places, yet are unwilling to undertake even a three-day journey for eternal salvation.” Retain a note explaining the rhetorical interpretation and the abrupt infinitive θέλειν. No alteration of the verified Greek is necessary; the replacement must receive fresh review.
